content.short: Major is a social 'task-to-earn' game on Telegram where players compete for rank and airdrop rewards.
content.description: Major is a social competition and task-to-earn application built as a Telegram Mini App. It encourages users to climb a global leaderboard by collecting 'Stars' through various social tasks, daily challenges, and friend referrals. Designed to reward active Telegram users, Major provides a straightforward and competitive path for airdrop eligibility. Its focus on social engagement and ranking has made it a significant tool for onboarding and retaining users within the growing TON gaming ecosystem.
content.meta: Climb the ranks and earn with Major on Telegram. Explore social gaming on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
